propositions: A single criterion's LLMBudgetExhaustedError during evidence gathering currently propagates and aborts the entire recovery, discarding all partial evidence and forcing the gate to offer --force-close, when partial evidence should be preserved and remaining criteria should still be evaluated.

Budget exhaustion (LLMBudgetExhaustedError, RunawayToolLoopError, or token-exhaustion UnretryableOutputError) in one evidence run should be caught, replaced with a content-free placeholder marking the criterion unverifiable-within-bounds, and recovery should continue with remaining criteria.

The finalizer must receive all N evidence entries even when some criteria exhaust their budgets, rendering per-criterion verdicts that correctly mark exhausted criteria as unmet/indeterminate rather than absent.
Recovery should only fail outright (raise CompletionRecoveryError) if EVERY criterion's evidence run fails, carrying diagnostic counts {criteria_total, criteria_exhausted}.
